results.title: Yedric.ai: AI Assistant Enhancing SaaS User Experience — Dynamic Business
results.content:
Yedric.ai is an embeddable AI assistant for SaaS and Shopify applications that lets users execute tasks through natural language. Rather than directing users to help articles or support teams, Yedric turns what they say—“change my billing plan,” “fix my broken integration,” or “turn off email notifications”—into actions via APIs or webhooks. This approach is aimed at reducing friction, improving the user experience, and surfacing product insights directly from what users are asking. Yedric is designed to be set up rapidly, configurable, and tightly integrated with a product’s existing documentation, context, and functionality.

## Key Features [...] ## Who is it for?

Yedric.ai is tailored to developers, product teams, SaaS founders, or Shopify app creators who want to enhance user experience by allowing users to ask for what they want in natural language, rather than forcing them to navigate UI menus or support documentation. Ideal use cases include: [...] ## Final thoughts

Yedric.ai offers a compelling approach for businesses looking to make their SaaS or Shopify product feel more responsive, intuitive, and useful. By transforming natural language input into actionable results, it reduces the gap between what users want and how they currently interact with product UIs. The free core plan and ability to use your own model keys make it particularly low risk to test. On the other hand, because pricing beyond model usage isn’t detailed publicly, and privacy around end-user data and transcripts is less clearly defined, larger organizations will want to investigate those areas before committing. For its target audience—product teams seeking improved UX and tighter feedback loops—Yedric.ai is a strong contender.

results.title: Yedric AI: Embeddable AI Agent for Your SaaS App
results.content:
### Who is this for?

Yedric is built for SaaS and app developers who want to make an existing product AI-native without building and maintaining their own agent experience. The site shows it already at work inside Shopify apps including MESA, Infinite Options, Smile, Tracktor, and Uploadery, so Shopify app teams are a clear audience. Product Hunt topics list SaaS, Developer Tools, and Artificial Intelligence, and the listing frames the buyer as a developer who wants users to control their SaaS with natural language. The second audience is the end users of those applications, who prefer asking for an outcome in plain language over learning where every feature lives and following help documentation themselves.

Yedric AI: Embeddable AI Agent for Your SaaS App [...] Yedric.ai is an embeddable AI agent that turns a SaaS application into an AI-native product. Rather than adding a chatbot that only answers questions and points users at a help document, Yedric lets users describe what they want in plain language and then carries the request through to completion using the product's own documentation, APIs, and existing tools. It is aimed at SaaS and Shopify app developers who want their users to control the product conversationally, and at the end users themselves, who should not have to learn where every feature lives. According to the Product Hunt listing, developers can make an existing product AI-native in under 30 minutes instead of building and maintaining their own agent experience. The problem Yedric addresses is a familiar one in software: [...] value proposition is that it converts a product's existing capabilities into something a user can simply ask for. By combining tool calling against your APIs with your own documentation, page-level context, secure session handling, observability, and bring-your-own-model keys, it lets an app take real actions from a natural-language request instead of stopping at an explanation. For development teams, that means an AI-native experience can be added to an existing product quickly rather than built and maintained from scratch, while users get an assistant that understands what they want and helps them get it done.
